# Generated CDP coverage

Source: pinned Chrome 152.0.7977.82. The schema contains 58 domains, 665 commands, 234 events and 611 named types. Wire types and parameter validation do not imply semantic support.

`implemented` declares the described command scope with regression evidence; `partial` records remaining limits; `unsupported` makes no semantic claim. Evidence links identify tests, not an assertion that every Chrome option is covered.
